hero.title: An investment in growth — priced for return.
hero.lead: We don't simply build websites — we create complete growth platforms engineered to generate leads, authority, and revenue for years. Here's how we structure that investment, and exactly what it's worth.
hero.summary: Cozelos Data, a digital agency in Vernal, Utah, prices work as an investment, not a commodity. Custom website projects start at $2,500 (Essential Presence), $4,500 (Professional Growth), and $7,500 (Market Leader), with Enterprise builds scoped from $10,000. Ongoing monthly growth plans run from $295 (Maintenance) to $1,500+ (Full Marketing). Every project begins with a $500 Discovery Session, credited toward your build.

philosophy.headline: The most expensive website is the cheap one that costs you customers.
philosophy.bodyHtml: A bargain template that loads slowly, ranks nowhere, and converts no one isn't cheap — it's a recurring loss. A well-built growth platform is the opposite: it pays for itself in new business, then keeps earning for years — which is why we build an asset rather than a website. Below is what that investment looks like.

discovery.title: Discovery Session
discovery.bodyHtml: Every great build starts with strategy. In a focused working session we map your goals, your customers, and your competition — then hand you a clear plan and a fixed quote. It's the single highest-leverage hour you'll spend on your digital presence, and the fee is credited in full toward your project when you move forward.

math.title: Why a custom asset costs more — and returns more.
math.p1: A custom Cozelos Data build isn't a generic theme stacked with plugins. It's a hand-engineered system that loads in under a second, has a far smaller attack surface, and needs less maintenance from day one. Every page is optimized for performance and search from the start — because the goal was never "a website." The goal is more customers.
math.p2: That's why we price by outcome, not by page count. You're not paying for pixels — you're investing in an asset that generates visibility, credibility, and revenue long after launch day.
math.p3Html: For a line-by-line look at what's actually being built, see what each of the six services includes. Questions about timelines, ownership, or what happens after launch are answered in the frequently asked questions.

guarantees.title: Guarantees, in writing.
guarantees.lead: Hiring an agency shouldn't be a leap of faith. Here's what you can count on from us — every project, every time.

items.body: Your domain, source code, and content are yours — always. No proprietary lock-ins, no hostage retainers.

items.title: Fixed quote, in writing
items.body: Your price is approved in writing before any work begins. No surprise invoices, no 'starting from' footnotes.

items.title: Engineered to perform
